clue.text: Flower mostly around middle of January opening quickly but temporarily

blocks.note: a red flower of the fields

explanation.surface: A flower that blooms briefly in midwinter, opening fast then closing again.
explanation.walkthrough: POPPY loses its Y to give POPP, which goes round U to make POP-UP.
explanation.definitionFit: A pop-up shop or window appears suddenly and lasts only a short while, hence opening fast and briefly.

clue.text: Power, ancient, is summoned

explanation.surface: Some old supernatural force has been called up, like a spirit at a seance.

clue.text: Typical posture of archer, prepared

explanation.definitionFit: Par for the course describes what is normal or to be expected, the same sense as an adjective meaning usual or standard.

clue.text: Dull experts upset spies

clue.text: People who entertain multitudes

clue.text: Arm injured, can one drink?

a rank or level, as of seats

clue.text: Good ship in legend certainly loaded with large grotesque carvings

clue.text: Turning back, receiving resistance is less common

clue.text: Representation of scene I love in play

clue.text: Keeping collection of data about lake and river for present

clue.text: Transformation of ape, bit ugly, seen in fairy tale

clue.text: Couple I phone at end of every year

clue.text: Synthetic fabric in fantastic gallery

clue.text: European cause arousing strong feeling

clue.text: Part of journey around north before next stretch

clue.text: Noble Yankee ahead of schedule
